description: Simulated gallery exhibit, CPU path-traced from actual supplied card geometry. This is not a museum photograph.
planar_glass_shadow_approximation: Clear shadow rays; surface reflection, transmission, 0.7mm wall thickness and Fresnel remain modeled
coordinate_system: Three.js / glTF: meters, +Y up, +Z relief face. Blender mapping: (x,-z,y).
layer_notes: Base excludes cover. Glass layer is physically rendered cover in isolation with no card, plinth or floor in any ray visibility. This removes secondary ghost artwork/reflections, enabling a clean removable overlay. Both images use exactly the same camera, crop and color transform. Glass refraction displacement is approximated in the CSS composite, with thin low-iron panes minimizing mismatch. Complete still is a reference full physical render. No glow, fog, bloom, painted reflections, or AI image edits.
